title: Platform API keys
description: Administrative keys for the /api/v1/platform API and the /mcp/platform MCP. Read only, on the platform hosts only; they never work on workspace routes.
newKeyHint: The key is shown only once. It works while you hold an internal role that allows the chosen scopes.

admin_customers_read.label: Customers (admin:customers:read)
admin_customers_read.desc: Companies with minimal commercial data: status, workspaces and plan (plan only for those who read billing).

admin_operations_read.label: Operations (admin:operations:read)
admin_operations_read.desc: Health of the worker and queues, and failed jobs, with no customer content.

created: Key created. Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
